gates: Confirm actual competition device SKU (USB versus M.2), delivered firmware, supported host OS, transport and matched HailoRT/DFC versions.
Obtain authorized DFC/SDK access and a supported build environment. No large toolchain, global installation, GPU or hardware purchase approved.
Verify source-weight license/checkpoint and input normalization. Parse intended AvgPool output or an adapted compact CNN using supported operators.
Quantize using ONLY fit-normal inputs; compare CPU, quantized emulator and compiled output shape/value/quality without tuning on final test.
Compile explicitly for HAILO10H; produce and hash a real HEF. Keep stock 1001-way classification HEF distinct from embedding HEF.
Execute on actual UGen300 via the supported transport. Record CPU preprocessing, transfer, NPU inference, CPU decision, device/host memory and energy separately.
Continue only if benefit beats RMS/CPU on a new locked evaluation. Current CNN pilot is not evidence of improvement over RMS.

sensorQualityExperiment20260928.measuredCpuOnly: The separate out-of-band gate added an FFT to CPU scoring; on A3 development it rejected just 1/78 white-noise healthy windows and also 61/78 unperturbed inner-race windows. This is not useful robustness or an NPU graph.
sensorQualityExperiment20260928.npuValueGate: An actual matching embedding HEF and UGen300 are prerequisites. Measure preprocessing, host-to-device transfer, neural inference, CPU reference scoring, host RSS/device memory and energy separately against RMS and the CPU CNN, then evaluate on previously untouched physically distinct bearings. No stock 1001-class output substitution.
